title: Influence and marginal contribution
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in\mathbb R$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. Suppose $f$ is monotone under inclusion and takes only the values $0$ and $1$. For each coordinate $i$, its Bernoulli subset influence equals $p(1-p)$ times its Bernoulli marginal contribution.
